tools.name: picorn_editor_duplicate_layer

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "picorn_render_svg" is 685 chars, far longer than this server's median (120). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: picorn_projects_inspect, picorn_editor_inspect_project · Private data: picorn_projects_create, picorn_projects_inspect, picorn_projects_update, picorn_generate_vector_assets, picorn_editor_create_slideshow, picorn_video_render_project · Public sink: picorn_video_import_media · Destructive: picorn_generate_vector_assets, picorn_editor_delete_slide, picorn_editor_delete_layers, picorn_editor_ungroup_layers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: picorn_projects_inspect, picorn_editor_inspect_project · Private data: picorn_projects_create, picorn_projects_inspect, picorn_projects_update, picorn_generate_vector_assets, picorn_editor_create_slideshow, picorn_video_render_project · Public sink: picorn_video_import_media · Destructive: picorn_generate_vector_assets, picorn_editor_delete_slide, picorn_editor_delete_layers, picorn_editor_ungroup_layers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
